This bean plot is small, and for beans I do not usually buy chemical fertilizer because it is costly and I save that kind of input for maize if I have any. I will plant my usual local seed and use some manure if I can gather it, and I will depend on the rains because we do not irrigate here. Most of the work will be done by my family, with only a few hired days if we need help at the busy time.
